title: Documentation for `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack` says `DirAccess` will not show changes made to `res://`, but it does.
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in 4.5, 4.4, and 4.3

### System information

Manjaro Linux - Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

According to the documentation, `DirAccess` should not show changes made to `res://` after calling `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack`, but calling `DirAccess.get_directories_at("res://")` seems to correctly shows the directories added by the .pck file.

I tested this both by running the project from the editor and by running an exported project and the behaviour seems to be the same.

I'm unsure if it is platform-specific, or if I misunderstood the documentation, but both `get_directories_at` and `get_files_at` seem to return all files added by the pack.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Add a directory containing a single script
3. Export the project as a `.pck` file
   * In the Resources tab of the export window, select "Export selected resources (and dependencies)"
   * Select the directory created earlier
4. Create another project
5. Put the previously created `.pck` file in the new project's user data folder.
6. Create a script to print the content of `res://`, load the `.pck` file, and print the content of `res://` again.

Sample code:
```gdscript
ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack("user://mod.pck")
for directory in DirAccess.get_directories_at("res://"):
	print(directory)
	for file in DirAccess.get_files_at(str("res://", directory)):
		print("\t", file)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[pck_dir_access_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23987974/pck_dir_access_mrp.zip)

The zip file contains the main project and three `.pck` files that have to be placed inside the `user://mods` directory.

Running the main scene will then print the contents of the `res://` directory before and after loading the `.pck` files.
